task.notes: Tries K10: the mirror of fold T3/Gata4rep1->rep2 (replicate 2 against WT E8.75, truth replicate 1), with the released wild-type series added for the reference's revert.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

s1x.factor: the source replicate's factor: K2a's estimator against WT E8.75 (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
s1x.depth: t3_decompose.estimate's per-label depth ratio of the source replicate: median cell depth per label, knockout / WT, 1.0 where either side has fewer than rules.yaml components.depth.min_cells cells
s1x.build: build_submission.construct and assemble with f=V.p, phi and ratio (the frozen stand-in xrep:F+depth); no composition, no stage mixing

s1x_res.factor: the source replicate's factor: K2a's estimator against WT E8.75 (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
s1x_res.depth: t3_decompose.estimate's per-label depth ratio of the source replicate: median cell depth per label, knockout / WT, 1.0 where either side has fewer than rules.yaml components.depth.min_cells cells
s1x_res.build: build_submission.construct and assemble with f=V.p, phi and ratio (the frozen stand-in xrep:F+depth); no composition, no stage mixing
s1x_res.residual: rho_g = (K7b's per-group revert factor / K7a's pooled revert factor) ** 0.5 for the cell's lineage group (1 for a group without a per-group factor); phi_raw x rho_g clipped to rules.yaml's factor clip; applied once with t3_decompose.apply_gene_factor
s1x_res.revert_rule: per lineage group with >= 200 cells: mean within-cell panel proportions; per group held by >= 3 other wild-type samples: log(mean + 1e-5) fitted on stage day by least squares, read at the reference's day; t3_decompose.gene_factor of that trend against the reference's group means (weights: the reference's group sizes; eps 1e-5; clip 0.25-4); exponent 0.5

s1x_res_perm.build: build_submission.construct and assemble with f=V.p, phi and ratio (the frozen stand-in xrep:F+depth); no composition, no stage mixing

s1x_res_perm.revert_rule: per lineage group with >= 200 cells: mean within-cell panel proportions; per group held by >= 3 other wild-type samples: log(mean + 1e-5) fitted on stage day by least squares, read at the reference's day; t3_decompose.gene_factor of that trend against the reference's group means (weights: the reference's group sizes; eps 1e-5; clip 0.25-4); exponent 0.5
